summary.principle: A searchable index of EVERY past/published deck's slides, built by engine/ingest_decks.py from real files (.pptx/.pdf/.html). PLAN searches this alongside the reference-library so it can reuse or adapt real prior slides instead of reinventing them. Recognizable About/bio slides found here are promoted into catalog.json as canonical candidates. This seed is empty until the first ingest run.
summary.content_hash_algo: sha256:16 — same content_hash() helper as catalog.json; per-slide hash over [title, text]; per-deck hash over the ordered per-slide hashes. Used for idempotent re-ingest (unchanged deck => skipped).
